description.en: Resizable split panels animated with Motion, featuring smooth folding and snapping.
description.zh: 基于 Motion 驱动的高性能可调节分栏面板，支持物理阻尼吸附与丝滑折叠动效。

content.en: motion-panels is an unstyled, fluid resizable panel library powered by Motion. Acting as an animated successor to react-resizable-panels, it provides real spring-driven folding, collapsing, and snapping transitions without relying on any external layout engine. The core engine is framework-agnostic with a lightweight React adapter, and supports one-line installation into projects via the shadcn CLI.
content.zh: motion-panels 是由 letstri 开发的纯粹、无预设样式的可调节分栏面板库。它以 Motion 为动效驱动核心，被称为自带真实物理折叠与吸附动效的现代化 react-resizable-panels 替代方案。底层引擎采用框架无关的原生 DOM 测量方案，上层提供极致轻量的 React 适配器与 shadcn 接入支持，折叠收起、跨级嵌套与拖拽分隔条均具备细腻的动画过渡。
